algorithms.title: Build the Scene Layout in 10 Minutes
algorithms.description: Do it on paper/whiteboard and on the radio.
steps: Identify the hazard and wind; set hot/warm/cold boundaries and mark them (tape, cones, flags).
Fix the command post in the cold zone with a clear view.
Choose the treatment area: upwind, flat, lit, sheltered, expandable, near a road.
Define the loading zone at the treatment exit; set a one-way vehicle loop.
Set staging on the approach route, out of sight; announce it.
Set a supervised green collection point and a screened morgue area.
Pick a helicopter LZ away from treatment if air resources are coming.
Broadcast the layout to all units; re-evaluate when wind/threat changes.
